posts.preview: The leather industry needs to be explored and strengthened to create more jobs throughout the entire skin and hide value chain. The transformation of the fishing industry must be duplicated in this industry. Currently, this industry is exporting jobs as far as Italy, Zimbabwe, South Africa, and many others. Imagine...
Today, being a National Players Day, let us pray for ourselves to think outside the box and support our industries
